verdict.rationale: Every conversion result comes out in open formats (Markdown, HTML, JSON, chunks), and the underlying models (Chandra, Marker, Surya) remain free open source. That means a user's processing outputs and workflow can be carried elsewhere, which lowers lock-in. However, nothing documents a way to bulk-export everything stored on the platform (stored files, pipeline configurations, extraction schemas, account history) or a clean account exit. Missing for 10: bulk account/data export, export of pipeline and schema configurations, a documented account-deletion/offboarding process, and independent corroboration.
